title: API Integration Plan
content:
### 1. Integrations
- **Stripe API** for secure checkout & webhook handling (Customer sessions, refund webhooks, idempotency keys).
- **SendGrid API** for transactional notification emails (Order confirmation, invoice PDFs).
- **Cloudinary API** for media assets and image transformation hosting.

### 2. Rate Limits & Edge Caching
- Implement Redis rate limiting at `100 req/min` per API key on `/api/v1/*`.
- Cloudflare Edge Cache for static product catalog items with 60s TTL.

### 3. Authentication & Security
- JWT Bearer tokens with 15-minute expiration and HTTP-only refresh cookies.
- HMAC-SHA256 signature verification on all incoming webhook routes.

title: Project Requirements
content:
### Core Feature Set
1. **Product Catalog**: Dynamic categories, facet filtering by price/color/brand, and real-time inventory count.
2. **Shopping Cart & Checkout**: Local state persistence, optimistic UI updates, Stripe Elements integration.
3. **Customer Portal**: Order history tracking, invoice downloads, address book management.
4. **Admin Dashboard**: SKU inventory management, low-stock threshold triggers, sales telemetry charts.

title: Project Brainstorming Notes
content:
### Ideas & Optimizations
- Consider implementing a 1-click checkout option for authenticated users.
- Explore vector search using pgvector for natural language search queries (e.g. "warm winter jacket for hiking").
- Implement live abandoned cart recovery emails triggered after 2 hours of inactivity.

title: Database Schema Ideas
content:
### PostgreSQL Tables
- `users` (id, email, password_hash, role, created_at)
- `products` (id, title, slug, price_cents, inventory_count, metadata_jsonb)
- `orders` (id, user_id, status, total_cents, stripe_payment_intent_id, created_at)
- `order_items` (id, order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price_cents)

### Indexes
- Index on `products(slug)` and `products(category_id)`
- Composite index on `orders(user_id, created_at DESC)`

title: UI/UX Design Notes
content:
### Visual Guidelines
- Clean neo-brutalist tech aesthetic with 2px borders and soft pastel accents.
- Outfit or Inter typography for crisp readability on high-DPI displays.
- High-contrast accessible color tokens adhering to WCAG 2.1 AAA compliance.
- Micro-interactions: Button click bounce, subtle hover lift, and spring animations on modals.

title: Portfolio 3D Canvas Specs
content:
### Three.js Pipeline
- Low-poly interactive developer desk scene with physics-based drag-and-drop items.
- Lazy-load WebGL context on scroll to optimize First Contentful Paint (<0.8s).
- Fallback 2D CSS card layout for low-power mobile devices and reduced-motion preferences.
